mapper.sql: select recording_id, device_id, user_id, user_name, session_id, kind, host_id, host_name, cols, rows_count, started_at, ended_at, chunks, bytes, complete, file_path, create_time, update_time from itm_audit_session
mapper.select:
and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and host_name like concat('%', #{hostName}, '%') and kind = #{kind} and complete = #{complete} and date_format(started_at,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d') and date_format(started_at,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
order by started_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into itm_audit_session (recording_id, device_id, user_id, user_name, session_id, kind, host_id, host_name, cols, rows_count, started_at, ended_at, chunks, bytes, complete, file_path, create_time, update_time) values (#{recordingId}, #{deviceId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{sessionId}, #{kind}, #{hostId}, #{hostName}, #{cols}, #{rowsCount}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{chunks}, #{bytes}, #{complete}, #{filePath}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from itm_audit_session where recording_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select recording_id from itm_audit_session where started_at < #{before} order by started_at limit #{limit}
